ns2:course.label: Plant Proteomics- Metabolomics
ns2:course.description: Broad introduction to plant proteomics and metabolomics, including a survey of contemporary methods and their applications for protein and metabolite identifications. Proteomics will include the study of posttranslational modifications and protein-protein interactions. Metabolomics will introduce the complexities on pathway tracing and elucidation. The focus of the course is on the application of proteomic-metabolomic approaches to answer biological questions. Tours of proteomic and metabolomic facilities will occur. Same as CPSC 468. Prerequisite: MCB 354; IB 472; or consent of instructor.
